notes.title: Trauma Football RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.notes:
My dearest friends, good day to you all, i have great news to share! Trauma Football, the result of 9 months of my own blood, sweat and tears is finally available on Steam! It's the project i'm the most proud of since i started game developing and it would mean a lot if you checked it out, and if you do, i hope you have as much fun playing it as i did creating it! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3757040/Trauma_Football"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: NEW RELEASE DATE, PRICE CHANGE AND MUSIC!
notes.notes:
So yeah, i got tired of waiting and since the game's done and i'm working on another project 30 Days to be the Best is coming out next monday.

Also now it's free lol

Other than that, i initially was supposed to compose the soundtrack for this game but i lucked out and found an old drum and bass album whose author allowed me to use it for free.
Why don't you take a listen?

[previewyoutube=Pn0EvoibRAk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
